description: This figure is a single rendered table (Table 4) listing Rietveld-refinement outputs for the non-equiatomic Fe40Mn19Ni15Al15Si10C1 high entropy steel. Columns are Condition, Phases, Phase Fraction, Lattice Parameter (nm), Volume (Å³) and Crystallite Size (nm). Five conditions are tabulated, each with refinement-quality metrics: 400 °C (wR = 2.088, GoF = 1.05, χ² = 1.10), 500 °C (wR = 2.279, GoF = 1.04, χ² = 1.07), 600 °C (wR = 0.252, GoF = 1.18, χ² = 1.40), 800 °C (wR = 2.84, GoF = 1.29, χ² = 1.67) and SPSed (wR = 3.326, GoF = 1.33, χ² = 1.78). Four phases are reported: BCC (lattice parameter 0.286 nm, volume 23.39 Å³), γ-brass type (0.872 nm, 663.05 Å³), B2 (0.289 nm, 24.12–24.13 Å³) and Fe5Si3 type (a = b = 0.667 nm, c = 0.466–0.468 nm, volume 179.54–180.31 Å³). BCC fraction falls from 57.00 % at 400 °C to 42.00 % at 800 °C, then rises to 56.00 % in the SPSed sample; γ-brass type falls from 21.30 % to a trace (1.60 % in SPSed), while B2 rises to 38.50–40.00 % at 600–800 °C and 34.00 % after SPS. Fe5Si3 type appears only from 600 °C onward (15.50 %, 14.00 %, 8.40 %). BCC crystallite size grows 21 → 29 nm. The table demonstrates the phase-evolution path with annealing temperature and after spark plasma sintering.

observations.observation: The table reports refinement-quality metrics for each condition: 400 °C (wR = 2.088, GoF = 1.05, χ² = 1.10), 500 °C (wR = 2.279, GoF = 1.04, χ² = 1.07), 600 °C (wR = 0.252, GoF = 1.18, χ² = 1.40), 800 °C (wR = 2.84, GoF = 1.29, χ² = 1.67) and SPSed (wR = 3.326, GoF = 1.33, χ² = 1.78).
BCC lattice parameter is 0.286 nm with volume 23.39 Å³ for all five conditions.
γ-brass type phase lattice parameter is 0.872 nm with volume 663.05 Å³ for all five conditions.
B2 lattice parameter is 0.289 nm; its volume is 24.12 Å³ at 400 °C and 24.13 Å³ at 500-800 °C and 24.013 Å³ for SPSed.
Fe5Si3 type phase has a = b = 0.667 nm and c = 0.466 nm at 600 °C, and c = 0.468 nm at 800 °C and for the SPSed sample.
BCC phase fraction decreases with annealing temperature (57.00 % at 400 °C, 47.70 % at 500 °C, 43 % at 600 °C, 42.00 % at 800 °C) and is 56.00 % in the SPSed sample.
γ-brass type phase fraction falls from 21.30 % at 400 °C to 36.30 % at 500 °C, then 3.00 % at 600 °C, 4.00 % at 800 °C and a trace 1.60 % in the SPSed sample.
B2 phase fraction is 21.70 % at 400 °C, 16.00 % at 500 °C, 38.50 % at 600 °C, 40.00 % at 800 °C and 34.00 % in the SPSed sample.
Fe5Si3 type phase is absent at 400 °C and 500 °C and appears only from 600 °C onward, with fractions of 15.50 % (600 °C), 14.00 % (800 °C) and 8.40 % (SPSed).
Crystallite size in nanometres: BCC 21, 23, 26, 28, 29; γ-brass type 12, 16, 19, 22, 21; B2 18, 20, 21, 25, 27; Fe5Si3 type 15, 20, 23 for 600 °C, 800 °C and SPSed respectively.
The caption states the table gives phase fraction, lattice parameter and crystallite size of the annealed samples at 400 °C, 500 °C, 600 °C, 800 °C and the SPSed sample of the non-equiatomic HES.
The citing text states the exothermic event at ~520 °C corresponds to formation of the Fe5Si3-type phase, and at 800 °C no phase change occurs but the amount of B2-type phase increases.
The citing text states that phase fraction, crystallite size and lattice parameter of the evolved phases were ascertained through Rietveld refinement, as reported in Table 4.
The citing text states the SPSed sample contains BCC (ferrite) as the major phase together with partially ordered B2 and trace amounts of γ-brass type and Fe5Si3 type phases.

subfigures.description: Single rendered table with 6 columns (Condition, Phases, Phase Fraction, Lattice Parameter (nm), Volume (Å³), Crystallite Size (nm)) and 5 condition blocks: 400 °C, 500 °C, 600 °C, 800 °C and SPSed; each condition lists 3-4 phases (BCC, γ-brass type, B2, and Fe5Si3 type from 600 °C onward) with their refinement quality metrics.
